intro: Upmods Beleza is bold and future-ready—plush comfort, ambient glow, and a majestic modular design come together to bring modern luxury and ease to your bedroom.

features.title: Cushioned headboard for comfort
features.text: A plush upholstered headboard gives you soft back support—perfect for late-night reading or lazy weekend mornings.

features.title: Ambient headboard lighting
features.text: Concealed lighting within the headboard creates a calming atmosphere—just right for winding down and setting the mood.

features.title: Majestic, modular design
features.text: The bold, elegant structure makes a statement, while the modular system lets you upgrade just the headboard whenever you wish.

features.title: Effortless motorized storage
features.text: Open and access under-bed storage at the push of a button—silent, smooth, and perfect for modern living.

features.title: Custom headboard upgrades
features.text: With Upmods modularity, you can swap out the headboard anytime—refresh the look, update the feel, and evolve your bed without replacing it entirely.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
